neighbours.label: Maharashtra: Mumbai, Pune, Marathi and the Shiv Sena; Bangalore, Delhi and Kerala stay low
fire: Local trains in Mumbai carry millions a day.
Software firms in Pune hired thousands.
The Shiv Sena won the city election.
In the end, Marathi newspapers sell well in the state.
Bollywood studios fill the suburbs of Mumbai.
The chief minister of Maharashtra met farmers.
Ganesh festival crowds filled the streets of Pune.
Fishermen in Mumbai sell their catch at dawn.
